facts.text: The William Vale is just steps from McCarren Park and the East River, in the center of Brooklyn's most creative neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: Just steps from McCarren Park and the East River, The William Vale is in the center of Brooklyn’s most creative neighborhood

facts.text: The L and G trains are a few blocks away, one stop from Manhattan.
facts.excerpt: with the L and G trains just a few blocks away, you’re one stop from Manhattan

facts.text: The William Vale has stood in Williamsburg since 2016.
facts.excerpt: Since 2016, The William Vale has been a striking fixture in the heart of Williamsburg

facts.text: All guest rooms and suites have private balconies over Brooklyn and the Manhattan skyline.
facts.excerpt: All guest rooms and suites feature private balconies, offering open-air vantage points over Brooklyn and the Manhattan skyline.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows, luxury linens and design-forward furnishings.
facts.excerpt: all of our rooms and suites offer private balconies with stunning views of Manhattan and Williamsburg, as well as floor-to-ceiling windows, luxury linens, and design-forward furnishings.

facts.text: Suites include the Junior King Suite, Manhattan View Corner Suite, King One Bedroom Suite and Vale Garden Residence.
facts.excerpt: including the Junior King Suite, Manhattan View Corner Suite, King One Bedroom Suite, and Vale Garden Residence

facts.text: The Manhattan View Corner Suite has a wraparound balcony.
facts.excerpt: Manhattan View Corner Suite Wraparound Balcony

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes a corner suite bathroom with a deep soaking tub set against a floor-to-ceiling window.
facts.excerpt: And don’t sleep on the deep soaking tub in the bathroom nestled right up against a huge floor-to-ceiling window.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says room designs are sleek and modern, with pops of color sourced from local Brooklyn artists.
facts.excerpt: The room designs are sleek and modern, warmed with a few random pops of color sourced from local Brooklyn artists.

facts.text: The hotel takes its name from a 19th-century Brooklynite whose property boundaries encircled the site.
facts.excerpt: The William Vale derived its name from a 19th-century Brooklynite whose property boundaries encircled the location of the development.

facts.text: Vale Park is an elevated green space with landscaped gardens, open lawns and skyline views.
facts.excerpt: Vale Park, our elevated green space featuring 15,000 square feet of landscaped gardens, open lawns, and skyline views

facts.text: Vale Park includes an herb garden overlooking the city.
facts.excerpt: Bask in our coveted green space and herb garden overlooking the city.

facts.text: Vale Pool is a summer pool with cocktails and poolside dining.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy refreshing cocktails and poolside dining for an effortless warm-weather escape.

facts.text: The outdoor pool has poolside cabanas, daybeds and lounge chairs.
facts.excerpt: Get some sun at the poolside cabanas, daybeds, or lounge chairs

facts.text: Winter Spa offers private panoramic barrel saunas and deep-soaking hot tubs.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in a unique wellness experience featuring private panoramic barrel saunas and deep-soaking hot tubs.

facts.text: The gym has iFIT-connected Freemotion equipment that auto-adjusts speed, resistance and incline.
facts.excerpt: state-of-the-art gym featuring iFIT-connected Freemotion equipment that auto-adjusts speed, resistance, and incline

facts.text: Williamsburg Beauty Spa, a family-owned neighborhood spa, is known for customized facials.
facts.excerpt: This family-owned neighborhood favorite is known for customized facials and results-driven treatments

facts.text: Guests can use The Malin Williamsburg coworking space with a day pass or meeting room booking at an exclusive rate.
facts.excerpt: Guests of The William Vale can access The Malin Williamsburg with a Day Pass, Multi Day Pass, or private meeting room booking at an exclusive rate

facts.text: Westlight offers 360-degree views over the Manhattan skyline, the East River and Williamsburg.
facts.excerpt: Offering 360-degree views overlooking Manhattan skyline, the East River, and the Williamsburg

facts.text: Food and drink are under the direction of James Beard Award winner Andrew Carmellini.
facts.excerpt: Thanks to the direction of James Beard Award winner Andrew Carmellini, food and drink at The William Vale are on another level.

facts.text: Leuca serves Southern Italian food with handmade pasta and wood-fired pizza.
facts.excerpt: Leuca brings the bold flavors of Southern Italy to Williamsburg with handmade pasta, wood-fired pizza

facts.text: Little Fino is an all-day cafe and bar.
facts.excerpt: All Day Cafe & Bar

facts.text: The hotel welcomes pets; a cleaning fee applies if a pet enters the room.
facts.excerpt: The William Vale welcomes pets. A $50 cleaning fee will be added to your stay if a pet enters your hotel room.

facts.text: Westlight, Leuca, Little Fino and Vale Park welcome locals as well as hotel guests, and Vale Pool may offer day passes in select seasons.
facts.excerpt: Westlight, Leuca, Little Fino, and Vale Park welcome both locals and travelers, while Vale Pool may offer public access through day passes during select seasons.

facts.text: Vale Pool is a summer amenity and Winter Spa a cold-season one; both close outside their seasons.
facts.excerpt: Experiences evolve throughout the year, from summer programming at Vale Pool to wellness-focused offerings at Winter Spa during the colder months.

facts.text: One percent of room revenue goes to hyperlocal non-profit organizations.
facts.excerpt: 1 % of our room revenue goes back to the community in support of hyperlocal, non-profit organizations

facts.text: Braille signage is used throughout the property.
facts.excerpt: Braille signage throughout the property

facts.text: Westlight Presents is a seasonal event series with rooftop parties and DJs.
facts.excerpt: Westlight Presents is a seasonal event series featuring rooftop parties, DJs, special programming, and curated experiences throughout the year.

facts.text: The William Vale has appeared in Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards.
The hotel claims the best views in Brooklyn, and arguably NYC.
facts.excerpt: With the best views in all of Brooklyn, and arguably NYC

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24/7.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your wellness journey at our 24/7 state-of-the-art fitness center.

facts.text: Westlight is on the 22nd floor of The William Vale.
facts.excerpt: Perched atop the 22nd floor of The William Vale

facts.text: Winter Spa is seasonal wellness programming on the terrace in cooler months.
facts.excerpt: come cooler months, guests can enjoy seasonal wellness programming—including a winter spa on the terrace
